wiki_acceptance_binary: A stone floor is buildable and gives a HIGHER move bonus than the wood floor.
summary: Added Mode.FloorStone to BuildManager.cs mirroring the EXISTING Floor entry exactly (1x1, no collider, sortingOrder-1 ghost, same cooldown/ghost/placement-validation/blueprint path) but paid from STONE (like WallStone) and placing a StoneFloorEntity (a FloorEntity SUBCLASS) that gives a HIGHER move bonus (1.50x paved vs wood 1.30x) via the EXISTING floor-bonus mechanism. New free hotkey K (B/F/G/T/Y/N/R/X/M/P/L all taken). New dedicated generator _gen_stone_floor.py emits stone_floor.png (cool grey-blue paved slabs on ROCK_DK/MD/LT + 1px OUTLINE_OBJ, darker/harder than wood floor). Lamp-style lazy procedural prefab/sprite path -> ZERO SceneSetup edit. Did NOT run Unity (QA verifies).

files_changed.what: Mode.FloorStone enum + floorStoneCost(석재1) + lazy floorStonePrefab/Sprite fields + K hotkey + switch arms (SetMode sprite & sortingOrder1, CostFor, PrefabFor, SpriteForCurrentMode, ModeKr) + PaysWithStone(m) helper (WallStone||FloorStone -> stone) wired into UpdateGhost affordability + DoTryPlaceAt needWood/needStone + 2s floor build time + EnsureFloorStoneSprite/EnsureFloorStonePrefab/LoadOrBuildFloorStoneSprite/BuildProceduralStoneFloorSprite (Lamp lazy-build mirror; prefab = SR sortingOrder1 + StoneFloorEntity + NO collider, like wood Floor).

NEW. StoneFloorEntity : FloorEntity (subclass so every GetComponent<FloorEntity>() consumer detects it as a floor with ZERO changes — indoor, tooltip, bonus). Overrides virtual MoveBonus to 1.50f (SerializeField stoneMoveBonus, designer-tunable). No collider.

FLAGGED minimal read-only-file edit (allowed by lane: 'tiny public bonus accessor if genuinely missing'). Added virtual MoveBonus (=> MoveSpeedMul, base wood 1.30x) + static BonusAt(Vector2 pos) returning the HIGHEST overlapping FloorEntity.MoveBonus (or 1.0 if none) via the same tiny OverlapBox the old IsOnFloor used. Legacy const MoveSpeedMul kept unchanged for back-compat.

FLAGGED 2-line change (NOT in forbidden list; required for the binary acceptance to actually hold at runtime). Both 'if (IsOnFloor(pos)) speedMul *= FloorEntity.MoveSpeedMul;' sites -> 'speedMul *= FloorEntity.BonusAt(pos);' so the stone floor's HIGHER per-instance bonus applies. Reuses the existing bonus mechanism — NO new movement system. NOTE: the now-unused private static IsOnFloor method was left in place (unused private method = no C# compile warning/error); QA may delete it as cleanup if desired.

NEW dedicated generator. Imports palette.py READ-ONLY (ROCK_DK/MD/LT, OUTLINE_OBJ). Emits stone_floor.png 16x16 (2x2 cut paving slabs, ROCK_DK mortar cross, ROCK_LT top/left bevel, full 1px OUTLINE_OBJ border) + _preview_stone_floor.png (8x 2x2-tiled QA). Pixel layout kept byte-for-byte in sync with BuildManager BuildProceduralStoneFloorSprite() so PNG and player-build fallback match. Did NOT edit _gen_sprites.py/_gen_fix_audit.py/_gen_lamp.py/_gen_scatter_variety.py/palette.py.
Generated 16x16 stone/paved floor sprite (143 bytes). Cool grey-blue, hard-outlined — visibly distinct from + darker/harder than the warm wood floor; recedes under pawns.

design_decisions: Subclass over standalone: StoneFloorEntity : FloorEntity gives >90% pattern overlap (indoor flag, floor detection, tooltip, bonus). Subclassing means every existing GetComponent<FloorEntity>() consumer keeps working with zero edits — the higher bonus is the ONLY delta, expressed by overriding the existing virtual MoveBonus.
Stone paid from STONE (PaysWithStone helper) mirroring WallStone, per wiki '#21 from stone'. Cost 석재 1 (cheap/reachable like wood floor's 목재 1).
Bonus values: wood 1.30x (existing), stone 1.50x = wiki paved-tile 50% (the comment already in FloorEntity). 1.50 > 1.30 satisfies the binary 'HIGHER'. Exposed as SerializeField for designer tuning.
Hotkey K chosen (B/F/G/T/Y/N/R/X/M/P/L all taken per lane brief).
